model_compatibility.claim_boundary: Packages cover the verified ACE-2 operator and shell paths. They do not claim arbitrary Transformer compatibility, full-model chat completion, or FPGA deployment.

packages.name: w4a8_projection
packages.title: W4A8 Projection Core
packages.summary: Reusable signed INT8 activation x signed INT4 weight projection MAC, requantization, bias, saturation, and overflow reporting.
packages.maturity: verified RTL core; Q/K/V may use legacy descriptors or the shell's ordered fused-QKV descriptor, while O, MLP gate/up/down, and LM-head roles remain separately scheduled

verification.proof_kind: shared shell proof of canonical standalone core
verification.proof_note: The focused Q-projection stride mode instantiates the canonical projection core through ace2_shell; other projection roles share this core but have separate operator demos.

known_limitations: The core computes one output accumulation at a time; matrix traversal, SRAM addressing, weights, scales, activation-tile reuse, and role scheduling belong to ace2_shell.
Fused QKV reuses this shared core in three ordered phases; it is not three physically parallel projection cores.
The focused package command proves Q projection, not every projection role.

packages.name: rmsnorm
packages.title: RMSNorm Core
packages.summary: Reusable streaming fixed-point RMSNorm for the ACE-2 896-element hidden vector.
packages.maturity: independently simulated RTL core with deterministic oracle vectors; the broader demo also provides a fresh challenge path

verification.proof_note: Runs ace2_rmsnorm_tb.sv against checked-in independent oracle vectors.

known_limitations: The public proof is parameterized around the Qwen2.5-0.5B hidden size and fixed-point formats; other dimensions/formats are not certified.

packages.name: rope
packages.title: RoPE Core
packages.summary: Reusable fixed-point rotary position embedding datapath for paired Q/K activation slices.
packages.maturity: verified RTL core with a paired Q/K shared shell proof

verification.proof_note: The +ROPE_ONLY proof executes both Q and K roles; rope-q and rope-k are names for the same paired run.

known_limitations: Position/scaling data is supplied externally.
The package does not provide a tokenizer, sequence scheduler, or arbitrary RoPE variant adapter.

packages.name: kv_cache
packages.title: KV Cache Path
packages.summary: Descriptor, memory, and state-machine path for verified KV writes in the ACE-2 shell.
packages.maturity: verified integration path; not an isolated standalone cache controller core

verification.proof_note: Runs the +KV_WRITE_ONLY ace2_shell proof; there is no claim of a separately instantiable KV-cache core.

known_limitations: KV storage allocation, host policy, long-context management, and cache reuse APIs are not standalone public IP.
The shell proof covers the demonstrated bounded context path, not arbitrary context lengths.

packages.name: attention
packages.title: Attention Datapaths
packages.summary: Reusable score and tiled value-composition cores plus their verified shell integration paths.
packages.maturity: standalone score/compose RTL cores with focused shell proofs
interfaces: score start and Q/K pair ready/valid

verification.proof_kind: two shared shell proofs of canonical cores and integration
verification.proof_note: Runs focused score and value paths. Softmax and KV write are separate packages and commands.

known_limitations: This is not a complete multi-head attention subsystem by itself.
Masking, head scheduling, memory traversal, softmax, and KV policy are shell/integration responsibilities.

packages.name: softmax
packages.title: Softmax Core
packages.summary: Reusable fixed-point bounded-context softmax with Q15 probability outputs.
packages.maturity: verified RTL core integrated and focused through ace2_shell

verification.proof_kind: focused shared shell proof of standalone core
verification.proof_note: Runs the +SOFTMAX_ONLY shell mode against the canonical softmax core.

known_limitations: The ACE-2 shell instantiates CONTEXT_MAX=8.
The LUT/rounding behavior is fixed-point ACE-2 behavior, not a general floating-point softmax implementation.

packages.name: silu_swiglu
packages.title: SiLU/SwiGLU Datapath
packages.summary: Reusable fixed-point SiLU lookup, gate/up multiplication, requantization, and saturation core.
packages.maturity: verified RTL core with focused shell proof
interfaces: gate and up packed beat ready/valid

verification.proof_kind: focused shared shell proof of standalone core
verification.proof_note: Runs the +SILU_ONLY shell mode and checks ACE2_SHELL_SILU_GATE_TB_PASS.

known_limitations: Gate and up projections are separate projection-core/shell operations.
The LUT and quantization formats are ACE-2-specific rather than arbitrary activation formats.

packages.name: mlp
packages.title: Qwen2.5 MLP Integration Bundle
packages.summary: Shared-shell composition of gate/up/down W4A8 projections, SiLU/SwiGLU, and residual update.
packages.maturity: verified operator and integration paths; not a single isolated MLP core

verification.proof_note: Runs every public MLP operator proof, including the slow full 896 x 4864 MLP-up projection.

known_limitations: No separately instantiable ace2_mlp_core module exists.
The MLP-up proof is slow under Icarus.
Weights, scales, memory layout, and command generation are external.

packages.name: qwen25_transformer_layer
packages.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B Transformer Layer Integration Bundle
packages.summary: Discoverable bundle of the canonical ACE-2 shell and cores used for the demonstrated Qwen2.5-0.5B W4A8 layer path.
packages.maturity: selected reusable cores plus shared shell integration; not a single drop-in layer core

verification.proof_kind: selected shared shell integration proofs plus separate fused-QKV benchmark
verification.proof_note: The package demo checks residual/post-norm and MLP-residual integration slices. Run `make fused-qkv-freeze && make fused-qkv-check` for the ordered Q/K/V activation-reuse proof. Neither command is a full-layer or full-model replay.

known_limitations: There is no single ace2_transformer_layer module.
The package demo is a selected integration proof, not full-model chat completion.
Host runtime, weights, tokenizer, unrestricted generation, and FPGA deployment are outside this package.
